dataList.content:
It was an unremarkable sort of day—if one could call it that—when even the Agents of the Upper Layer had been mobilized to suppress and return Alriune to its containment unit.
为追捕出逃的异想体爱娜温，甚至出动了上层员工的平凡的某天。

With the Control Team left hollowed out, the child had been saddled with managing the Abnormalities assigned to the department.
由于控制部的人员空缺，孩子被委任了异想体的管理工作。

P.M.P.C.
<ruby=狗屎主管，狗屎队长>     狗·管·狗·队。</ruby>
dataList.title:
Welfare Team Agent
福利部 员工

dataList.content:
As soon as she stepped into the Old Lady's containment unit, the child sat reclining in a chair and crossed her legs, unfiltered complaints spilling out of her mouth.
孩子一进入老妇人的收容单元，就靠在椅子上，跷着腿开始发泄自己的不满。

All day long, she'd been tasked with doing Managerial Work on Alriune to extract its E.G.O gear...
为了提取E.G.O装备，孩子今天一整天都被派去管理爱娜温……

... and she failed. That's three times already—seven, actually, by the manager's yardstick—that she'd allowed Alriune to escape under her watch today alone.
光是今天就已经失败了三次。按主管的标准来看，已经让爱娜温在她眼皮子底下出逃了七次。

I don't see how that pink mongrel breaking containment is my fault.
我不明白为什么那粉色的野兽出逃算是我的过错。
dataList.title:
Welfare Team Agent
福利部 员工

dataList.content:
It's that dimwit of a manager. Must've bled out every scrap of luck because he couldn't resist rubbernecking at the thing every now and then.
那混蛋主管总是改不掉停下来盯着那东西看的毛病，肯定是因为他一直看……我才变得倒霉的。
dataList.title:
Welfare Team Agent
福利部 员工

dataList.content:
Alriune. That sorrowful child slips out of containment when the Work Result is "Bad"... and just as readily on a "Good."
爱娜温。那悲伤的孩子……无论工作结果是优还是差，都会一次又一次从收容单元中出逃。

It's never content to remain confined. It would much rather wander outside, suffusing the company's musty corridors with the fresh scent of the forest.
不是被收容着，而是到外面去，为这公司霉臭的空气染上森林的香味。

Haha... Things must look quite unfair, from where it stands.
呼呼……从孩子的角度来看，会觉得很不公平吧。

And, of course, from where the manager stands too.
当然，从主管的角度来看，也会觉得很不公平。

dataList.title:
Abnormality
异想体

dataList.content:
Tsk. No flower-viewing today. Just stuck hearing the old hag droning on all day.
啧。今天连花都没得看，只能一整天听这老太婆说话了吗。
dataList.title:
Welfare Team Agent
福利部 员工

dataList.content:
It's become pitch-black, this room. The curse must've seeped into the walls—been a while since I last did some work here.
不过，这漆黑的诅咒……是太久没来的缘故吗，已经逐渐侵染了整面墙壁。
dataList.title:
Welfare Team Agent
福利部 员工

Abnormality
异想体
dataList.content: Dearie, dearie... would you like to hear a story? 孩子，孩子，要不要我给你讲个过去的故事？

*puff* Whatever.
呼……行吧。
dataList.title:
Welfare Team Agent
福利部 员工

dataList.content:
Tales crooned like lullabies, poems too abstract to grasp, ghost stories that make the hair on the back of the neck stand straight up.
如同摇篮曲一般的歌谣，抽象的诗句，阴森的怪谈。

From stories known to all... to the ones known to none.
从人尽皆知的故事，到无人知晓的故事。

The Old Lady knows every tale ever told—every single story in existence, every nursery rhyme written for children.
老妇人知晓世界上所有的故事、所有唱给孩子们的歌谣。

It goes without saying that her troves of tales also include the secret stories of the other Abnormalities.
当然，那其中也包括其他异想体的故事。

Just a coincidence, perhaps. Or is it inevitability?
是偶然，还是必然呢。

For the first time, the Old Lady brought up a tale of an Abnormality—an entity that the child knew all too well.
老妇人第一次讲起了一个孩子再熟悉不过的异想体的故事。

dataList.title:
Abnormality
异想体
dataList.content: Oh, Alriune, the lovely one; a doll who yearned to be human. 可爱的爱娜温。想成为人类的人偶。

dataList.title:
Welfare Team Agent
福利部 员工

dataList.content:
Know something about that rabid thing?
关于那个到处胡作非为的家伙，你知道些什么吗？
dataList.title:
Welfare Team Agent
福利部 员工

dataList.content:
A flicker of surprise crosses the child's face as she voices her question, but the answer, in all likelihood, won't be hers to hear.
孩子一惊，猛地这样追问道。不过大概不会得到回答。
The Old Lady, you see, doesn't speak to you. She merely speaks, spinning her tales and making her loneliness known. 只是不断讲述着故事，忙于诉说着自己孤独的老妇人……

dataList.title:
Abnormality
异想体
dataList.content: Its eyes were full of soul, and it was adored by people. 瞳中寄宿着灵魂的爱娜温，生活于人们的喜爱之中。

dataList.title:
Welfare Team Agent
福利部 员工

Abnormality
异想体
dataList.content: But every genesis of the spring is to be followed by the passing of the autumn. 然而于春的诞生后，必然会有秋的逝去。

The Old Lady does no such thing as asking. She doesn't "respond," either. The words that come out of her mouth are not for conversation.
由于不会进行包括提问在内，任何能够称之为沟通交流的对话。

Which is why, for all the stories she tells, she can never manage to fill the void of her loneliness.
因而无论她知晓多少故事、讲述多少故事……都只会一直感到孤独。

dataList.title:
Abnormality
异想体
dataList.content: One day, the doll was abandoned in a dark forest. 有一天，人偶被遗弃在了黑暗的森林之中。

dataList.title:
Abnormality
异想体
dataList.content: Its eyes were stolen by crows lusting for glitter, 贪求闪亮之物的乌鸦，偷走了它的眼珠。

dataList.title:
Abnormality
异想体
dataList.content: while its mind, life, and heart slowly withered away. 内心、生命与心跳渐渐消逝。

dataList.title:
Abnormality
异想体
dataList.content: Part by part, its pretty porcelain body cracked and shattered. Where its eyes once were, only gaping holes were left. 美丽的瓷器片片碎裂、双目变得空空如也……

dataList.title:
Abnormality
异想体
dataList.content: And yet, the doll remained standing in the forest. 即便如此，人偶仍然站在森林之中。

dataList.title:
Abnormality
异想体
dataList.content: The cracks and openings on the porcelain were instead filled with a growing bouquet of flowers, and fresh petals fluttered down like tears from the empty holes of its eyes. 在破碎的裂隙间生长出成片的花朵，空空的眼眶中青色的花瓣如同泪水流溢般落下。

And then? What happened next?
所以，之后发生了什么？
dataList.title:
Welfare Team Agent
福利部 员工

dataList.content:
Did it hunt down the crow that pecked its eyes out? Did it cut off its wings?
去找到那只乌鸦，把它的双翼剪掉了吗？
dataList.title:
Welfare Team Agent
福利部 员工

dataList.content:
The child knew that no answer would be returned;
明明知道并不会得到回答。

That she would still get to hear the next part of the story, whether or not she invited the Old Lady to continue.
因此，即便不去问也能从之后的话语中得知。

Still, ask she did...
但那孩子仍然向她发问。

... as though she were used to such exchanges.
似乎已经习惯于这种对话方式。

dataList.title:
Abnormality
异想体
dataList.content: Alriune, lacking eyes but all-seeing; a human who yearned to be a doll. 即便如此仍然能看见一切的爱娜温，想成为人偶的人类。

dataList.title:
Abnormality
异想体
dataList.content: Born of soil, and to soil shall it return. 既然是自泥土中诞生、就只是归于泥土中去罢了。

The Old Lady directed her gaze at the child—a gaze as hollow as that of the Alriune from the story, a black void that seems to meet the child's own eyes.
如同童话中的爱娜温一般，老妇人用空洞的目光与孩子对视。

It was almost as though she were interested in hearing what the child would make of the tale.
就像在询问孩子自己的故事如何，有什么感想一样。

The child's eyebrows cinched together in a scowl. The tale might have found footing had she cared to listen with interest, but this was not for her. She really should have spared herself the trouble of hearing it out, she thought.
要是有意思就好了，但这东西听了还不如不听，孩子皱起的眉头大概传达着这样的意思吧。

dataList.title:
Welfare Team Agent
福利部 员工

dataList.content:
Your story's literally otiose, needless, empty.
空洞、又虚有其表的故事。
dataList.title:
Welfare Team Agent
福利部 员工

Abnormality
异想体
dataList.content: But surely that was not the end of the story for the doll. 但这并不是人偶故事的结局。

dataList.title:
Welfare Team Agent
福利部 员工

dataList.content:
Perhaps the story hit a bit too close to home, or maybe it reminded the child of a certain someone she only remembered in the foggy fragments of her memories...
是因为感觉这个故事与自己相似，还是觉得像是破碎模糊的记忆之中的某个人呢。

Either way, a cloying loneliness clung to the child as she stepped out of the containment unit.
走出收容单元的孩子身上，有孤独的气息散出。

... And who the hell are you?
……你这家伙又是谁？
dataList.title:
Welfare Team Agent
福利部 员工

Information Team Agent
情报部 员工
dataList.content:
Oh! I'm Vera, from Information. You're that Agent who transferred to the Middle Layer from the Safety Team, right? Uh...
啊……我是情报部的维拉。你就是那个从安保部下到中层来的……

Ryōshū.
良秀。
dataList.title:
Welfare Team Agent
福利部 员工

Information Team Agent
情报部 员工
dataList.content:
Right! Right, Ryōshū. I've heard quite a bit about you.
啊，是，良秀女士。久仰您的大名。

*puff* Hmph. What do you want?
呼……有什么事？
dataList.title:
Welfare Team Agent
福利部 员工

Information Team Agent
情报部 员工
dataList.content:
I came down because Mister Yesod gave the order for support. There was no one in the Control Team... anyhow, thought I smelled something burning in the lobby, and...
Yesod先生说控制部空着，叫我来支援，在赶过来的路上……在大厅那边闻到了烧焦的味道。

dataList.title:
Information Team Agent
情报部 员工
dataList.content:
Yup. I see that you, uh, Altered your E.G.O Gift into... a cigarette. Ah, not an issue, I guess, as long as it's not a fire...
是把E.G.O饰品……变调成香烟了啊……不是发生了火灾就好。

The employee extended a hand for a handshake, but the child slapped it away like a high-five and moved toward the hallways....
孩子像是要击掌一样轻轻拍了一下那名员工伸出的手，准备向走廊的方向走去。

... only to be stopped by the flustered employee blocking her path.
但由于那名员工慌张地拦住了她，因此没能成行。

dataList.title:
Information Team Agent
情报部 员工
dataList.content:
Uh, please... Just a moment. Please wait here until the Control Team arrives.
啊……等一下。请等到控制部的人来了再回去吧。

And why should I do that?
为什么要那么做？
dataList.title:
Welfare Team Agent
福利部 员工

Information Team Agent
情报部 员工
dataList.content:
You missed the announcement, I take it. The Dusk of Amber will begin shortly.
你应该错过了广播吧。琥珀色的黄昏马上就要开始了。

dataList.title:
Information Team Agent
情报部 员工
dataList.content:
And... during the Dusk of Amber, the effectiveness of RED—that is, physical attack—is doubled.
而且……对琥珀色的黄昏使用RED。也就是物理攻击的效果会变为大概两倍。

Doubled? That multiplier nonsense you people like to play with, hmm?
两倍么。看来是说你们提出的那种数字游戏。
dataList.title:
Welfare Team Agent
福利部 员工

Information Team Agent
情报部 员工
dataList.content:
Correct. Ryōshū, your E.G.O weapons are both WHITE-type. I recommend either switching weapons or leave this to the other Agents...
是的。良秀女士您所携带的E.G.O武器都是WHITE类型。我建议您更换武器或交给其他员工来处理……

You're N.S.F.P.
哈。知·一·不·二。
dataList.title:
Welfare Team Agent
福利部 员工

Information Team Agent
情报部 员工
dataList.content:
Pardon?
什么？

You're not seeing the full picture.
你这家伙。只知其一不知其二啊。
dataList.title:
Welfare Team Agent
福利部 员工

dataList.content:
The child brushed past the employee and walked into the corridor with light steps.
轻松地无视了挡在身前的员工，孩子走进了走廊。

Look closely, M.B.
好好看着。乌·众。
dataList.title:
Welfare Team Agent
福利部 员工

dataList.content:
If switching E.G.O gear is what allows double the efficiency, all I need to do is use both of my weapons at once instead.
效果相差两倍的话，同时使用两把E.G.O武器不就行了吗？
dataList.title:
Welfare Team Agent
福利部 员工

Information Team Agent
情报部 员工
dataList.content:
Uh... What?
什么？

I'll show you the collaboration of F.A., S.
就让你见识一下余·孤的合作吧。
dataList.title:
Welfare Team Agent
福利部 员工

dataList.content:
A gigantic worm burst into the hallway.
巨大的虫子从走廊中飞扑而出。

As the ordeal entity advanced slowly, yet not without momentum, the child raised her crossbow and took aim.
孩子盯着以看似缓慢、实则丝毫不慢的速度冲来的考验，将弩对准了它。

The employee, who frantically chased after the child, watched the bolt flying from the crossbow,
当着慌忙追上来的员工的面，孩子在射出弩箭的同时……

and in the same breath, the child's revolver fired six rounds at the ordeal at a speed too fast for the eye to track.
以目光难以企及的速度，用左轮手枪连续射出了六发子弹。

Hmm. Was that not enough?
呼……还不够吗？
dataList.title:
Welfare Team Agent
福利部 员工

Information Team Agent
情报部 员工
dataList.content:
Th-that's why I told you to either switch weapons or wait!
我、我不是都说了叫你换把武器或者等一下吗！

dataList.title:
Information Team Agent
情报部 员工
dataList.content:
Look, it's not too late to go back and—
现在赶快回去吧……

Well, more shots should do the trick, then.
如此。那多打几下就行。
dataList.title:
Welfare Team Agent
福利部 员工

dataList.content:
One shot. Then two. Then a third.
一枪、两枪、三枪。

Bolts and bullets rained down on the ordeals until they burst like squashed fruit,
小虫子们被不断射出的弩箭与子弹炸飞。

and another bolt loosened at point-blank range punched straight through the largest of them—the Dusk itself.
眼前射出的弩箭直接将名为黄昏的巨大虫子贯穿。

*puff*
呼。
dataList.title:
Welfare Team Agent
福利部 员工

dataList.content:
Not a dull end to wrap up a day.
作为一天的结束而言不算无聊。
dataList.title:
Welfare Team Agent
福利部 员工

Information Team Agent
情报部 员工
dataList.content:
W-wait... Why are you aiming that thing at me?!
等、等下。为什么朝着我——

The child, perhaps, had managed to reshape the loneliness that latched onto her into an artistry of her own,
也许是那孩子将笼罩在房间中的孤独升华为了艺术吧。

because she no longer seemed lonely at all as she emptied her gun on the horrified employee.
向着惊慌失措的员工开枪的她看起来并不孤独。
